notes.title: Time Knight VS. Zombies - Update 2.0
notes.content:
Hello,
We are pleased to share with you this new major update.

-Addition of a new stage comprising 18 levels with a new boss, totaling 90 levels of gameplay.

-The knight now has a shield that can be activated by right-clicking with the mouse or by pressing the LB button on an Xbox controller. The shield makes the player invincible and deals damage to nearby enemies. Shield activation is indicated in the stamina bar.

-Four new enemies have been added to the game:
-The Axe Orc
-The Conquistador
-The Halberdier
-The Thief Goblin

-Gems can now be collected by killing enemies and bosses. These gems can be used to unlock accessories and potions in the shop:
-A magnet that attracts coins towards the player
-A drone that automatically shoots nearby enemies
-A circular saw that rotates around the player and cuts enemies
-A speed potion that increases running speed
-A strength potion
-An endurance regeneration potion

-A training room allowing practice with all weapons against a few enemies is now available in the tutorial menu.

-Enemy artificial intelligence has been improved.

-The "easy" mode now offers 75 seconds to complete a level, and the mission difficulty has been eased.

-New achievements have been added:
-"It takes just one sword"
-"I'm all geared up"
-"I'm not even stained"
-"I'm rich, Rich, RICH"

-Fonts have been made more legible.

-Existing levels have been enhanced.

-Minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Today's update brings a lot of improvements!

- The easy difficulty now includes 90 seconds instead of 60.

- The normal and normal+ difficulties now include 45 seconds instead of 30.

- The hard, hard+, and yolo difficulties still include 30 seconds.

- The "Watch" bought in the shop now gives 5 more seconds instead of 3.

- There is no longer a need to wait for the stamina bar to completely reload before running.

- The ground traps and lasers no longer harm the player in the easy, normal, and normal+ difficulties.

- You can now hit the red laser switch at any time to reset the activation timer.

- The battery indicator of the yellow laser is more accurate.

- You can now shoot faster with the bow.

- The arrows of the bow and crossbow now have homing functionality.

- A lives counter is now displayed in the shop.

- Slimes are easier to hit and easier to dodge.

- The shop videos should now play correctly and not freeze.

- The game is now supported on Steam Deck, thanks to the verification of multiple users.

- Minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.4
notes.content:
Hello, Guten Tag, Hola, Bonjour, Buongiorno, Dzień dobry, Olá !

In this new update, the localization of the game has been done in the following languages :

-German
-Spanish
-French
-Italian
-Polish
-Portuguese

Now, all the text in the game is translated. If you detect an anomaly or an error or a better translation, please contact us.

Teraz cały tekst w grze jest przetłumaczony. Jeśli zauważysz jakąś anomalię, błąd lub lepsze tłumaczenie, skontaktuj się z nami.

Agora, todo o texto do jogo está traduzido. Se você detectar alguma anomalia, erro ou uma tradução melhor, por favor, entre em contato conosco.

Have a good day and have fun !

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
A lot has been done in this update 1.0.0.3 !

-You can attack and move at the same time when wielding the sword, axe, crossbow, pelletbow. It is indicated in the shop with which weapon you can walk and attack at the same time.

-It is now easier to attack with the sword and the axe.

-The appearance of the cursor has changed, it is now easier to see it on the screen

-You now skip the tutorial with the right click/ enter key or the "B" button on a xbox controller

-Videos are now compatible with any Steam Deck

-Minors bug fix
